name: Pingo Notify – Automation & Notification Chat Messages
author: Infixs

sections.description:
Pingo Notify is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to help you notify your customers and site administrators via messaging apps like WhatsApp. Unlike other solutions, it offers free monthly message sending with a monthly limit perfect for small businesses. For enterprises requiring higher message volumes, we offer paid plans.

✨ Key Features

  • 🆓 Free Monthly Messages: Get started with free monthly message allowance for small businesses
  • 🎨 Highly Customizable: Extensive customization options to fit your needs
  • 🔧 Extendable: Seamlessly integrate with other popular WordPress plugins
  • 💫 Modern Interface: Clean, intuitive dashboard with user-friendly controls
  • 🏷️ Smart Placeholders: Auto-complete functionality makes it easy to know which variables you can use in messages
  • 🛒 WooCommerce Integration: Full compatibility with latest WooCommerce versions
  • 📝 Works Without WooCommerce: Perfect for blogs and non-ecommerce sites too
    • 🧩 Dokan Marketplace Compatible: Send suborder notifications using Dokan-specific template variables for marketplace vendors

🔗 Integrations & Use Cases

📢 Content Notifications

  • Notify blog subscribers about new posts
  • Alert administrators and editors about site activities
  • Send various types of notifications to different user roles

🛒 WooCommerce Compatible

  • Full integration with WooCommerce order management
  • Support for order status changes and updates
  • Compatible with latest WooCommerce versions
  • Integrate with shipping plugins to notify customers about delivery progress
  • Send status updates and tracking information
  • Keep customers informed throughout the order lifecycle

🚀 PRO Features

Upgrade to Pingo Notify PRO for advanced messaging capabilities:

  • 🖼️ Send Images: Include product images and visual content
  • 📎 File Attachments: Send download files and documents
  • 😊 Stickers/Emojis: Add fun elements to your messages
  • 🎬 Video Messages: Share video content and tutorials
  • ♾️ Unlimited Characters: No restrictions on message length
  • 📈 High Monthly Limits: Handle enterprise-level messaging volumes

🚀 Getting Started

  1. 📥 Install and activate the plugin
  2. ⚙️ Configure your messaging settings
  3. 🎯 Set up your notification triggers
  4. 📝 Customize your message templates
  5. 💬 Start engaging with your customers!

🌐 External Services

This plugin connects to Pingo Notify external service (https://pingonotify.com) to send WhatsApp messages and notifications. When you use this plugin, certain data may be transmitted to our servers to process and deliver your messages.

📊 Data transmitted may include:

  • 💬 Message content and recipients

🔒 Privacy & Legal

Privacy Policy: https://pingonotify.com/policies/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://pingonotify.com/policies/terms-of-use

🛠️ Development Files

This plugin includes compiled JavaScript assets.

GitHub: https://github.com/infixs/wordpress-pingo-notify
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Pingo Notify”
  4. Click Install Now on the Pingo Notify plugin
  5. After installation, click Activate
  6. Go to Pingo Notify in your admin menu to configure the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file from WordPress.org or your account
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  4. Click Upload Plugin at the top of the page
  5. Choose the downloaded zip file and click Install Now
  6. After installation, click Activate Plugin
  7. Go to Pingo Notify in your admin menu to configure the plugin

Manual FTP Installation

  1. Download and extract the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the infixs-pingo-notify folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  4. Navigate to Plugins > Installed Plugins
  5. Find “Pingo Notify” and click Activate
  6. Go to Pingo Notify in your admin menu to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
💰 Is Pingo Notify free to use?

Yes! Pingo Notify offers free monthly message allowances perfect for small businesses. For higher volume needs, we offer affordable PRO plans.

📱 Do I need WhatsApp Business API?

No, you don’t need your own WhatsApp Business API. Pingo Notify handles all the technical integration for you through our service.

🛒 Does it work without WooCommerce?

Absolutely! While Pingo Notify has excellent WooCommerce integration, it works perfectly for any WordPress site – blogs, portfolios, business sites, and more.

🎨 Can I customize the message templates?

Yes! Pingo Notify provides a user-friendly interface with auto-complete placeholders, making it easy to create custom message templates for different scenarios.

📢 What types of notifications can I send?

You can send various notifications including order updates, cart abandonment reminders, shipping notifications, new post alerts, user registration confirmations, and custom admin notifications.

🔒 Is my data secure?

Yes, we take data security seriously. All communications are encrypted and we follow strict privacy policies. Please review our privacy policy for detailed information.

🖼️ Can I send images and files with PRO?

Yes! PRO users can send images, files, stickers, videos, and have unlimited character limits with higher monthly message allowances.

⬆️ How do I upgrade to PRO?

You can upgrade directly from your plugin dashboard or visit our website to explore PRO plans and features.
